passage: One summer evening, just as Leo was brushing his teeth, every light in the house flickered and went out. The street outside went dark too. 'A power cut,' said Dad, lighting a candle. Leo felt a little nervous — until Mum opened the back door. 'Come and look,' she whispered. Because the street lamps were off, the night sky was filled with more stars than Leo had ever seen. A pale river of light stretched across the sky. 'That's the Milky Way,' said Dad. 'It's always there. The city lights usually hide it.' Leo gazed up until bedtime, and he was almost sorry when the lights came back on.
passageTitle: The Night the Lights Went Out
prompt: The passage says the lights 'flickered' before they went out. What does 'flickered' mean?

options.text: Went on and off quickly, unsteadily

explanation: Flickered means the light shook and went on and off unsteadily — the passage says every light flickered and then went out.
